messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to use get_stock_prices function to retrieve stock prices for Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla for durations 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month. They want separate durations for each? The phrasing: "蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價" means each company has a different duration: Apple 1 week, Microsoft 2 weeks, Amazon 3 weeks, Tesla 1 month. So we need to call get_stock_prices with companies array and duration string. But the function signature expects companies: string[] and duration: string. It seems we can only pass one duration per call. We could call multiple times: one call for Apple with 1 week, one for Microsoft with 2 weeks, etc. Or we could combine all companies but same duration? But the requirement is different durations. So we need multiple calls.

We should call get_stock_prices four times. Provide each call. Use function calls. The assistant should produce function calls. According to policy, we should not provide explanation. Just function calls. So we will produce four function calls.
